facts.fact: Alice 视角：Emily 一进门，她这一晚就开始脱轨。
facts.anchor: Everything started going wrong for Alice the moment Emily walked in.

facts.fact: 她把整晚按步骤事先安排妥当。
facts.anchor: She had planned it all in advance, step by meticulous step.

facts.fact: Gareth 被安排当她的“僚机”，本人却还不知道。
facts.anchor: who would play the part of her wingman, though he didn’t yet know it

facts.fact: 她私下买了两张 Majestyk 的票，好让自己将来答得出千禧夜是怎么过的。
facts.anchor: she had secretly bought two tickets for Majestyk for herself and Gareth

facts.fact: 她盼 Emily 在出门前就醉倒，好让 Matty 看清她是个累赘。
facts.anchor: she would indeed pass out before they left the house

facts.fact: 她压着惊恶注意到 Emily 那件廉价上衣透出身体，并认定是故意的。
facts.anchor: Alice noticed, with muted horror, that Emily’s nipples were visible through the material of her cheap-looking top.

facts.fact: JJ 刚劝 Emily 慢点喝，转眼就提议喝 shots，还说去加油站买龙舌兰。
facts.anchor: A moment ago he was warning Emily to slow down. Now he was suggesting shots.

facts.fact: Emily 顺势接住“酒加零食”的提议，用一句“长夜还长”收住全章。
facts.anchor: ‘How about shots and snacks?’ said Emily.
